Some browsers provide privacy settings or signals indicating preferences about tracking.

If we become aware of a security incident involving personal information, we will assess the incident and take appropriate steps.

Cookies are small text files that websites may store on your computer, smartphone, tablet, or other device when you visit them.
Cookies can help websites recognize a browser, maintain shopping sessions, remember preferences, and support certain features.
For example, cookies may help an online store:
* Remember items added to a shopping cart.
Cookies do not automatically provide a website with access to all information stored on your device.
The information collected depends on the specific cookie and its purpose.
Depending on our website configuration, we may use cookies and similar technologies to support the following activities.
Cookies may help maintain essential shopping features, including cart contents, checkout sessions, and account authentication.

If advertising or remarketing services are enabled, cookies or similar technologies may help measure campaigns or support relevant advertising.

Session cookies generally operate during a browsing session.
They are typically removed when the session ends, although exact behavior may vary.
Persistent cookies may remain on your device for a defined period or until they are deleted.
They can help remember preferences or support returning-user functionality.
The expiration period depends on the specific cookie and its configuration.

lines: At lumeero, we believe that online shopping should be accessible, convenient, and inclusive for everyone.

We are committed to improving the accessibility and usability of our website so that customers with different abilities, needs, and assistive technologies can browse products, access information, and shop with greater confidence.
This Accessibility Statement explains our accessibility goals, the standards that guide our efforts, how we address accessibility concerns, and how customers can request assistance.
This statement applies to https://lumeero.us, operated by Stone Canyon Leathers, doing business as lumeero.
At lumeero, accessibility is an important part of creating a positive online shopping experience.
We aim to make our website usable for as many customers as reasonably possible, including individuals who experience:
* Other conditions that affect digital interaction
Our goal is to identify and reduce barriers that may prevent customers from accessing our products, services, and information.
We recognize that accessibility is an ongoing process requiring regular attention and improvement.
We use the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) as a reference for our accessibility improvement efforts.
These guidelines are developed by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) and provide internationally recognized recommendations for making web content more accessible.
Our intended accessibility benchmark is WCAG 2.2 Level AA, where reasonably achievable and applicable.
WCAG is organized around four principles:
Perceivable: Information and interface elements should be presented in ways users can perceive.
Operable: Navigation and interactive components should be usable through appropriate input methods.
Understandable: Content and website functionality should be clear and predictable.
Robust: Content should work with a range of browsers, devices, and assistive technologies.
This statement describes our accessibility objectives and does not represent a certification or claim that every page currently conforms to WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
We aim to incorporate accessibility considerations into the design, development, and maintenance of our website.
Areas of focus include the following.
We aim to organize website content with understandable menus, headings, and navigation elements.
This helps customers locate products, policies, and support information more easily.
We aim to support navigation and interaction using a keyboard wherever practical.
This includes important features such as:
Our objective is to reduce barriers for customers who cannot use a mouse or touchscreen.
We aim to use readable text, appropriate spacing, and clear content structures.
We also aim to avoid unnecessary complexity in important shopping instructions and customer policies.
We aim to consider sufficient contrast between text, controls, and their backgrounds.
This can help customers with low vision or color-vision differences distinguish important information.
Where appropriate, we aim to provide meaningful text alternatives for informative images.
For product images, descriptive alternative text can help customers using screen readers understand relevant visual content.
Decorative images may be handled differently to avoid unnecessary announcements.
We aim to make important website forms understandable and usable.
Our accessibility objectives include clear labels, understandable instructions, and helpful error messages.
We aim to support customers using desktop computers, laptops, tablets, and smartphones.
Responsive layouts can help customers access content across different screen sizes and orientations.
We aim to improve compatibility with commonly used assistive technologies, including screen readers, keyboard navigation, and browser accessibility features.
Compatibility may vary depending on the device, browser, assistive technology, and website component.
We recognize that accessibility is especially important during the purchasing process.
We aim to make essential shopping activities as accessible as reasonably possible, including:
* Adding items to the shopping cart
If you experience difficulty completing a purchase because of an accessibility barrier, please contact us.
Our support team can review your concern and help identify an available alternative way to obtain information or assistance.
We aim to present product information in a clear and organized manner.

We recognize that images alone may not provide sufficient information for every customer.

If you encounter a compatibility issue, please let us know.
We recognize that some customers rely on keyboard navigation instead of a mouse.
If you cannot access an important feature using your keyboard, please report the issue so we can investigate.
Many browsers and devices offer built-in tools for adjusting text size and page magnification.
Customers may find these features helpful when reading product information or completing forms.
We aim to support reasonable enlargement and responsive presentation without unnecessary loss of content or functionality.
Our website may include product photographs, graphics, promotional materials, and other visual content.

If you encounter an accessibility barrier involving a third-party feature on our website, please contact us.
We will review the issue and consider available alternatives or improvements.
We recognize that some parts of our website may not yet provide an optimal experience for every user.
Potential areas requiring review may include:
* Older or newly introduced website components
This list identifies areas that may need assessment; it is not a confirmed list of existing defects.
We have not represented this website as having completed an independent accessibility certification or comprehensive conformance audit.
As issues are identified, we aim to evaluate their impact and prioritize appropriate improvements.
Accessibility is an ongoing responsibility rather than a one-time project.
The scope and timing of improvements depend on technical requirements, available resources, and the impact of identified issues.
We aim to prioritize barriers that significantly affect customers' ability to access essential shopping functions.

Automated tools alone cannot identify every accessibility issue.

Yes. We aim to improve the accessibility and usability of our website for customers with different abilities and needs.
We use WCAG 2.2 Level AA as an intended accessibility benchmark. This does not constitute a claim of verified full conformance.
Can I use a screen reader on your website?
We aim to support screen reader compatibility, but performance may vary across website features and assistive technologies.

Keyboard accessibility is one of our improvement priorities. If you encounter a barrier, please report it.

You may contact our team to request a more accessible explanation or format. We will review the request and available options.

Email info@lumeero.site with the affected page URL and a description of the issue.

No. You do not need to disclose a disability diagnosis to report a website accessibility barrier.

Resolution times depend on the issue and its technical complexity. We aim to prioritize barriers affecting essential shopping activities.
If you need assistance using our website or would like to report an accessibility concern, please contact us.
